reviews.title: Deleted all my photos
reviews.text: Title. I spent 3 hours swiping through photos, checked multiple times that the app was deleting as it went, then finished swiping through my entire camera roll and the app deleted all my photos besides 4 random ones that I’m pretty sure I swiped left on. They ended up in recently deleted so I could at least get them back, but this was a total waste of time since I could either go through my camera roll individually restoring every picture I wanted or restore everything and have to manually delete every picture individually, which is exactly what I was trying to avoid. Screw this app man. Waste of time and requires a subscription. I’m cancelling while I’m in the free trial but if I had paid for this I would be furious.

reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: I will be brutally honest here. First of all, it is not free. I really wish these companies would stop saying that the app is free when it is only free to download and not free to use. So be aware before getting into this, you will have to pay a subscription. Also, as far as cleaning up duplicate photos, the reason I downloaded this in the 1st place, it is useless. If you have pictures put in albums and not just kept in a main photo folder, it tags them as duplicates because you have them in albums. Not what I downloaded the app for and not what I agreed to pay the subscription for. At all. So on the whole, just another useless. Junk app that it's not worth wasting your money on.

reviews.title: Disappointing and misleading free trial
reviews.text:
I signed up for Cleaner Kit Pro because it advertised a free trial, but I was required to enter my card details upfront. I genuinely believed I had deleted the app before the trial ended, but unfortunately I hadn’t, and I was charged for a week without realizing it.
I immediately requested a refund, but Apple refused, and the developer offered no meaningful support. This experience felt misleading and frustrating, especially since the app relies on easy-to-miss subscriptions.
I would strongly caution others to be extremely careful with the free trial and subscription settings before downloading. Overall, this left a very negative impression.

reviews.title: Completely useless app
reviews.text: I am completely outraged at my experience with this useless app. I agreed to seven day a trial, and tried to cancel on the last day. To begin, all this app does is allow you to select or deselect photos and other items that take up storage and choose to keep or delete them which you could easily do manually without having to pay $30 for an app. Then when you realize that you’ve overpaid for a useless app, you get an error message when you try to cancel telling you to try again later. I tried many times to no avail. I was notified the next day that I had been charged and when I requested a refund, this was denied. I cannot protest enough how much this app has wasted my time and money. Don’t allow yourself to get ripped off like I was.

reviews.text: A waste of time. Free trial is limited, impossible to unsubscribe on the app, nothing about unsubscribing in the FAQs, had to go via App Store.
